description: Elections Commission - The Supplementary Electoral Register 2024 (1) for the Period Starting from the First day of February 2024. to the thirty first day of May 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, including the certification of a supplementary electoral register and the allocation of parliamentary seats to electoral districts based on voter registration data. It is issued by the Election Commission under constitutional authority (Article 98(8)) and contains a schedule detailing the number of members each electoral district is entitled to return, which falls squarely under election-related administrative matters.
